content.result_snippet:
Hello doston, mera naam hai Sudhansu aur aap dekh rahe hain Raat 3 Baje. Doston, aaj ki yeh kahani uss andhere ki hai jab insani ka dar uski hadd paar kar jaata hai. Yeh kahani ek aise post ki hai jahan sirf khamoshi aur purani aadatain baaki theen. Toh chaliye ab bina waqt zaya kiye aaj ki kahani ko sunte hain.

Yeh baat 1999 ki hai. December ka mahina tha. Main bataur forest officer naya-naya duty par join hua tha. Mera pehla aadesh tha ki is area ki security check ki jaye. Us samay wahan ek purana factory tha. Us factory ke aas-paas bahut saare jungle the. Main uss security post par baith kar bandobast dekh raha tha. Mere paas ek purani jeep thi. Us jeep mein humari duty ka saara samaan tha. Maine uss post ke aas-paas gasht lagayi thi.

Shaam ka waqt tha. Suraj dhal chuka tha. Andhera tezi se fail raha tha. Main uss post par akela tha. Mere paas ek radio tha. Woh radio aksar khamosh rehta tha. Mujhe lagta tha ki koi mujhe sun raha hai. Maine apne duty register mein sab kuch likha tha. Maine har niyam ka palan kiya tha. Pehla niyam tha ki koi bahar se na aaye. Doosra niyam tha ki koi andar se na nikal paaye. Teesra niyam tha ki koi bhi aadesh bina sign ke na maane. Maine in sab niyam ko dhyan mein rakha.

Raat gehri ho chuki thi. Temperature bahut gir gaya tha. Mere shareer par thandak ka ehsaas ho raha tha. Maine apne jacket ko tight kar liya tha. Mere kaan mein bas apni saans ki awaaz aa rahi thi. Maine uss post ke darwaze par nazar rakhi. Uske peeche ek bada metal door tha. Aur woh uss darwaze ke peeche se... kadmon ki awaaz sun pa raha tha. Woh awaaz bahut dheere aa rahi thi.

Maine apne hath ko table par rakha. Mere hath kaanp rahe the. Maine apni aankhon ko ghumaya. Maine uss dark corridor ko dekha. Woh corridor factory ke andar jaata tha. Main uss corridor se door tha. Par mujhe laga ki koi mujhe dekh raha hai. Maine apne radio ko check kiya. Usmein koi signal nahi tha. Maine uss post-mortem report ko yaad kiya. Woh report uss factory ke baare mein thi.

Me
